reportTitle: Phase A.1 Protected Vercel Preview Verification Report
statusRationale: In accordance with Rule 5 ('หากเปิด Protection ไม่ได้ ให้หยุดและห้าม Deploy ข้อมูลจริง'), remote Vercel Preview execution with live inventory data is held as NOT_RUN_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE until Vercel Deployment Protection or synthetic data masking is configured.

tests.name: Unauthenticated initial landing state
tests.expected: Redirect to /#/login; stock_data.js and promotion_variants.js not loaded in memory
tests.actual: Redirected to /#/login; window.STOCK_DATABASE is null; Data Loading Gate held scripts
tests.evidence: URL: http://localhost:8080/#/login; DOM #view-login visible; script[src*='stock_data.js'] count = 0

tests.name: Development Login and on-demand data fetch
tests.expected: Login transitions to /#/home and dynamically initializes STOCK_DATABASE in memory
tests.actual: Navigated to /#/home; DataLoader loaded stock_data.js on demand; total stock items = 218

tests.name: Protected route redirect before login
tests.expected: Navigating directly to /#/stock without session redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: Route Guard intercepted request; redirected to /#/login

tests.name: Tab refresh preserves session
tests.expected: Refreshing /#/stock maintains session without returning to login
tests.actual: Reloaded page on /#/stock; user remained authenticated on /#/stock

tests.name: Logout purges session and memory datasets
tests.expected: Logout clears sessionStorage, removes STOCK_DATABASE from memory, redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: sessionStorage cleared; DataLoader purged window.STOCK_DATABASE (null); redirected to /#/login

tests.name: Browser Back button after logout
tests.expected: Pressing back button after logout cannot expose protected stock or home content
tests.actual: Popstate route guard forced redirect back to /#/login; protected views remained hidden
tests.evidence: Protected content display: none; user remains on #/login

tests.name: Zero stock numeric formatting
tests.expected: Items with 0 stock display numeric '0' via 0
tests.actual: All zero stock items render numeric '0' wrapped in .stock-zero span
tests.evidence: SM-A075FZKDTHL rendered '0' for F1 and F2

tests.name: Stock quantity derived from item.f1/item.f2 directly
tests.expected: Row counts are bound directly to item.f1 and item.f2, not KPI aggregates
tests.actual: DOM row cells strictly bound to item.f1, item.f2, and item.total per P/N
tests.evidence: Table row <td> values correspond 1:1 to item.f1 and item.f2

tests.name: Remote Vercel Preview HTTP Asset Status
tests.expected: All assets on remote Vercel preview branch return HTTP 200 without 404 or MIME errors
tests.actual: Held as NOT_RUN_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE pending activation of Vercel Deployment Protection
tests.evidence: Vercel Deployment Protection requires organization dashboard configuration before public deployment of proprietary stock files
